textSegments: 80 PLUS Platinum certified fully modular PSU with a ultra-quiet 14cm fan and smart fan control.

Adopted with an advanced design for high performance PCs, the Toughpower 1500W is certified with 80 PLUS Platinum and 100% Japanese capacitors to ensure the reliability and stability while powering up the whole system. Thanks to the ultra-quiet 140mm fan with smart fan control, the Toughpower 1500W can operate silently at peak performance. Last but not least, its designed to satisfy the DIY enthusiasts, Toughpower 1500W comes with three changeable side stickers to match your dream PC build.
The Toughpower 1500W adopts a 140mm fan, the larger fan ensuring the overall good cooling performance and silent operation under heavy load.
Designed with our Smart Zero Fan, the fan will not spin until the load exceeds 30% of the power supply, minimizing the fan noise.
All ripples are lower than 30mV on +12V, +5V or +3.3V from 0% to 100% load to ensure a stable operation and keep your performance-critical components to function reliably for longer.
The voltage regulation, more strict than Intel’s standard ±5% for major rails and ±10% for -12V, is set to no more than ±2% for major rails to meet the highest performance.

Offers cable selection for users while powering the system at an advantageous voltage. Low-profile flat black cable makes cable management easier, reduces clutter and increases airflow inside the chassis.
Four sets of SATA connectors (550mm + 150mm + 150mm + 150mm) x 4
Four sets of 1 x PCI-E 8pin connector (600mm) x 1
Four sets of 1 x PCI-E 6+2pin connectors (600mm)
Two sets of Peripheral connectors (550mm + 150mm + 150mm + 150mm) x 4
Peripheral to Floppy adapter cable (150mm) x 1
Providing great durability as well as offering the highest stability, while remaining reliable.
Powerful single +12V rail ensures a stable and reliable supply to other PC components.
Stylize Sticker to Match Your PC Build
Toughpower 1500W comes with three different stylish side stickers. By simply changing the sticker, you can style your power supply to match your PC build.
80 PLUS Platinum Certified and Intel C6/C7 States Ready

Toughpower 1500W saves energy through its high energy efficiency up to 93% at 50% load, and is certified to 80 PLUS® Platinum. It has been optimized to work with all generations of Intel’s processors to achieve maximum energy saving.

Toughpower 1500W is certified to CYBENETICS PLATINUM in terms of efficiency level. The PLATINUM overall efficiency rating is defined as ≥91% to <93% of 230V input. There are six ETA certifications, covering an efficiency range from 82%. Besides the overall efficiency of a PSU, ETA also takes into account its overall Power Factor readings along with the efficiency of the 5VSB rail and the power that the unit consumes in standby (also called phantom power).
CYBENETICS – NOISE LEVEL CERTIFICATION – STANDARD+ Ready

Toughpower 1500W is certified to CYBENETICS STANDARD+ in terms of noise level. There are seven noise level certifications, covering from dead silent PSUs (<15db[A]) to quiet noisy ones(>40 db[A]). We use a solid methodology and state of the art equipment to measure the noise that a PSU outputs throughout its entire operation range, from almost zero noise output to full load.
